title: Refresh onboarding.json managed hashes for every .bee/bin file this feature edited
action: Per exec-speed plan (ledger parity). After es-1/es-3/es-4/es-5 cap: recompute sha256 (hex, over raw bytes) for every .bee/bin/** file changed by this feature (bee.mjs; hooks/adapter.mjs, bee-tools-logger.mjs, bee-write-guard.mjs, bee-state-sync.mjs; lib/command-registry.mjs, lib/guards.mjs, lib/guard-lite.mjs new entry) and update the matching entries under managed.helpers / managed.lib / the hooks section of .bee/onboarding.json via a small node script (never hand-typing hashes). Add guard-lite.mjs as a NEW managed.lib entry alongside its siblings. updated_at refreshed. Verify: node .bee/bin/bee.mjs status --json reports onboarding drift:false.

truths: only hash values + updated_at + the one new lib entry change in onboarding.json

trace.outcome: onboarding.json managed hashes refreshed for the 8 edited/new .bee/bin files (bee.mjs; 4 hooks; command-registry, guards, NEW guard-lite); status --json reports drift:false
